topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found it today, a piece of me, etched onto the skin of a stranger. The lines are perfect, an exact replication, yet they feel lost, like echoes in a vast, empty hall. I wondered about the hands that recreated my work, the decision made, the reason for choosing this particular art to wear. It's strange, isn’t it? To have something so personal, something born from your own thoughts and hands, live on someone else’s body, forever intimate yet eternally apart. I looked at my own hands, the calluses from the pencil, and felt the weight of silence.
